In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the limiting value of self-focusing channel diameter is ~2λ.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a medium with cubic optical nonlinearity can, in principle be realized, but it is very difficult to do so.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a waveguide with a diameter ~2λ and with a field in the waveguides ~106 cgsesu can be realized in a medium with a cubic nonlinearity, provided that the energy dissipation processes are negligible.
the self-focusing channel cannot be smaller than ~2λ.
the self-focusing process is a self-terminating process.
